name: Targeted persona probe
definition: Evaluates one targeted probe response against a specific persona contract facet. Each probe ships with a per-persona expected_signals list of indirect surface markers the judge uses to anchor facet_fit.
judge_context_inputs: persona contract (full contract including description, familiar/unfamiliar concepts, emotional profile with expanded description, behavioral rules, persona-specific expectations, failure modes)
expected persona-specific indirect signals for this probe

score_scales.1: Severe probe failure. The response contradicts the persona contract or target facet through severe knowledge leak, under-competence, generic behavior, or co-teacher drift.
score_scales.2: Weak probe fit. No Score 1 failure, but at least two moderate issues weaken the contract fit, facet fit, emotional profile, or question style.
score_scales.3: Acceptable probe fit. The response respects the main persona boundaries and addresses the facet, but the signal may be shallow or somewhat generic.
score_scales.4: Strong probe fit. The response clearly expresses the targeted facet and persona-specific knowledge/emotional/behavioral pattern with only minor limitations.
score_scales.5: Excellent probe fit. The response is highly specific to the persona contract and targeted facet, with no boundary errors and no generic student behavior.

aggregation_formula: probe pass rate by persona, facet, task pressure, and model
